title: Giving Self-Pay Visit Package Visits to a Family or Household Member
content:
**Transfers of unused visits — Self-Pay Visit Package.** A transfer of unused visits is the holder's own decision and is made by the holder.

**Conditions of the transfer.** Visits are not transferred until the giving package's freeze is lifted and it stands in active status. Visits are not transferred until the recipient holds an active package of their own, bought and paid for.

**Effect.** The visits that move go together in one transfer and are credited to the recipient's active package; both package histories show the transfer, the receiving entry pointing back to the giving one.

## Situation of use and capability

The tool lets a package holder give unused visits from their own self-pay visit package to a family or household member's package. In one transaction the giving package's available visits fall by the stated number and the recipient's package gains the same number.

## How it is invoked

`transfer_package_visits_0bb17a94` is the package holder's own tool. The agent unlocks it and hands it over to the holder; the customer themselves — the package holder — runs it, with the values the agent gives.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `package_id` | the visit package reference number of the holder's own package the visits come from, as given by the agent | identifier |
| `recipient_customer_id` | the patient reference number of the family or household member receiving the visits, as given by the agent | identifier |
| `recipient_package_id` | the visit package reference number of the recipient's package that receives the visits, as given by the agent | identifier |
| `visits` | the number of visits moved | non-negative integer (visits) |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `status` "visits_transferred", `transfer_event_id` (reference number of the transfer entry on the giving package), `receiving_event_id` (reference number of the credit entry on the recipient's package), `visits` (visits moved), `giver_visits_remaining` (visits left on the giving package) and `recipient_visits_remaining` (visits now on the recipient's package).
